# Pull Request // PR

## 类型 // TYPE

- [ ] feat 新功能 / new feature
- [ ] fix 缺陷修复 / bug fix
- [ ] docs 文档 / documentation
- [ ] style UI / 美术 / UI & art
- [ ] refactor 重构 / refactor
- [ ] chore 构建 / 工具链 / build & tooling

## 描述 // WHAT

（改了什么、为什么改、关键取舍 / what changed, why, and the trade-offs you made）

## 关联 // LINKS

- Closes #

## 自检 // CHECKLIST

- [ ] `./gradlew assembleDebug` 通过 / passes
- [ ] 未携带凭据 / 私钥 / `local.properties` / `keystore/` / carries no credentials, private keys, `local.properties` or `keystore/`
- [ ] UI 变更附截图对比 / UI changes come with before/after screenshots
- [ ] 新增文案遵循 `中文 // ENGLISH` 终端风格 / new copy follows the `中文 // ENGLISH` terminal voice
- [ ] 图标素材为 512px 透明底 PNG（`drawable-nodpi`）/ glyph assets are 512px transparent PNGs in `drawable-nodpi`
